description: Implement a safety check in the response reasking logic to prevent crashes when processing reasoning model outputs. The system should gracefully handle ResponseReasoningItem objects that lack tool call arguments during validation error retry attempts.
functional_requirements: Add attribute checking before accessing tool call arguments in the response reasking function
Ensure validation errors are properly propagated to the LLM during retry attempts when using reasoning models
Maintain backward compatibility with existing tool call processing logic
